limitations: Only seven newly added files executed; prior Chapter/Audio/DASH failures remain open outside this run.
ASR capability skips and pre-skip selected identities do not establish native processing. Multi-plugin cases count separate identities; identity totals are not unique test totals.
ASR has no speech recognition service or physical speaker verification; forced fallback branches remain explicit.
Chromecast SDK is controlled. No receiver, discovery, real Cast SDK or remote playback acceptance.
VAST controlled source tests replace a dependency and remain outside installed coverage; real IMA gate remains separate.
Generic runtime/type consumer covers core/chapter only. Some existing package architecture wording was updated after preparation; publication still requires a fresh final pack.
